plans.name: CUDA/model-load sanity check
plans.success: fixed revision loads once; two tokenized prompts forward-pass finite; CUDA device/peak memory JSON recorded
plans.auto_stop: 300 s wall cap, VRAM >2.5 GiB, exception, NaN/Inf
plans.failure: stop immediately; preserve diagnostics only; no retry in same paid run

plans.name: GRPO 0.5B single-update smoke
plans.lora: policy BF16 LoRA r=16 alpha=32 dropout=0; q/k/v/o
plans.checkpoint: save final adapter only after successful update; save_total_limit=1
plans.success: exactly one optimizer update; 8 bounded completions; finite loss/reward; artifacts/checksum complete
plans.auto_stop: 900 s, 1024 generated tokens, 8 completions, VRAM >10 GiB, OOM, NaN/Inf
plans.failure: OOM: stop and report measured peak, then propose shorter completion/smaller batch; NaN: retain metrics and stop; timeout: terminate gracefully, no automatic rerun

plans.name: PPO 0.5B single-update smoke
plans.lora: policy r=16 alpha=32 q/k/v/o; value r=8 alpha=16 q/v plus score head; BF16
plans.checkpoint: save final policy/value adapters only after successful update; save_total_limit=1
plans.success: exactly one PPO optimizer update; 4 bounded responses; finite policy/value/KL metrics; artifacts/checksum complete
plans.auto_stop: 1200 s, 512 generated tokens, 4 completions, VRAM >14 GiB, OOM, NaN/Inf
plans.failure: OOM: stop and report component/peak, then propose batch 2 with grad-accum 2; NaN: retain metrics and stop; timeout: terminate gracefully, no automatic rerun

artifact_contract: Each run saves config.json, summary.json, metrics.csv, gpu_metrics.csv, stdout.log, stderr.log, checksums.sha256, reward/loss/KL/VRAM charts as applicable, and only the stated adapter checkpoint.
